title: Lyons's advice never to step backwards; a sound by accident
summary: Lyons tells him Fletcher Henderson is making a mistake going back to a dance hall and offers to put the band in his place.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: And the when the "Covered Wagon", I had it fixed with the Indians in there and all that. Well, this was the beginning. Well, Lyons was very pleased with this, you see. So he said to me, "Well, I'll tell you, Fletcher Henderson is making a mistake. He's going from a cabaret back to a dance hall. And you never step backwards." And he's the first one told me, he said, "Gertie Saunders has made that same mistake. She left a musical comedy to go into burlesque. Which is a step beneath." And you never step backwards, see. And he said, "The only time that you go from that, it's like with the sublime and the ridiculous. The ridiculous never precedes the sublime. It always comes after." You see, so -- and these points he set down and -- and he told me all these points, see. He was a Russian Jewish fellow. I didn't know he was Russian Jewish then. I didn't know what he was. I knew he was Jewish though. And he was a nice guy, see. So he said, "Now, I can get you down this -- in about four or five weeks, Fletcher will be through there, and he's going to the Roseland. And you can go over and follow him in there, if you want to." He said, "I'll put the

show in there, and I'll put the show in this fall." You see, so that was the beginning so, now, we'd worked harder, but we'd lost interest in the Nest. We wasn't interested in the Nest, now. We wasn't working for the Nest now, we was working for when we leave the Nest, you see?

And then Johnny and them, one day, Old Barron Man Bryan said, "Sam, I see that you can duplicate yourself, and you have done better. I was betting that you couldn't do it the second time. But you've done it and you've done it better." Which it was different, but I still don't realize the word 'sound'. I don't know about that yet, see?
This is, in a way of speaking, a fluke. And I've hit on something that I really don't know I'm on, see?
And that's the reason the band now, the band I have today, is different. I hit on the same thing. But this time, I was looking for it.
